timecoded_text_to_speech.text: On September 11th, 2001, as a student in Bokeh, Riton, I heard the calling and I answered
it as a naval aviator, I accomplished the mission and dangerous in extreme environments
to serve America with devotion, duty and honor.
On January 6th, 2021, that calling was never stronger, and I'm answering it again.
I'm Curtis Calibriis, and I'm running for Congress and Florida's 22nd District because
it's time for real leadership, leadership with integrity and sacrifice, not from political
ambition, leadership that will bring our country together.
From the military to federal service, I've been preparing for this job my entire life.
As a Navy combat veteran, I defended America's freedom, I hunted Russian submarines and
As a former federal inspector, I entered the safety of the American public.
I investigated aircraft accidents and enforce federal flight standards.
As a proud American citizen and husband, my top mission is to serve my country and my
fellow Americans as a leader for change in DC.
It is time we answered the call.
I ask that you join me on this mission to unite our country because we are the United
States of America and we are stronger united.
